Act Lifecycle Workflow

Type: Cluster

ID: klefs5yh13dopt31i9ysfzis

The lifecycle of an act in the HL7 v3 Reference Information Model: preparatory (new, held), active, suspended, and the terminal states completed, cancelled, aborted, with nullified and obsolete outside the normal course. The generic clinical and administrative act state machine. Paths: Main path (new > active > completed); new-held (new > held); held-new (held > new); new-cancelled (new > cancelled); active-suspended (active > suspended); suspended-active (suspended > active); active-aborted (active > aborted); suspended-aborted (suspended > aborted); completed-obsolete (completed > obsolete); new-nullified (new > nullified); held-nullified (held > nullified); active-nullified (active > nullified); suspended-nullified (suspended > nullified); completed-nullified (completed > nullified).

Semantic Links:

skos:closeMatch: http://www.w3.org/2005/01/wf/flow#State

dcterms:source: http://terminology.hl7.org/
dcterms:identifier: https://axius-sdc.com/library/provgov/act-lifecycle
skos:exactMatch: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActStatus

Act Lifecycle: active aborted states

Type: XdOrdinal

ID: ildygh9zrok9h3wxgqutovbe

States of the active aborted path of the Act Lifecycle workflow, in order: active, aborted. A transition is legal between adjacent states. The lifecycle of an act in the HL7 v3 Reference Information Model: preparatory (new, held), active, suspended, and the terminal states completed, cancelled, aborted, with nullified and obsolete outside the normal course. The generic clinical and administrative act state machine.
